## 4. Architecture and implementation decisions

See ADR-006. Root Next stays; /mobile owns manifest/lock/runtime/strict TypeScript.
Expo Router is user-selected provisional baseline (not Phase 1 direct React Navigation).
Router contains its navigation primitives internally; no standalone @react-navigation
packages are installed. Six route files bundle: root layout/index and public/private
layout/probe pairs. Stack.Protected closes private group while checking; private layout
checks again and keys the stack to identity/generation. No final product routes or
callback processing. Interview/recovery entry implementation remains deferred.

Auth provider starts checking and verifies getUser(token) before authenticated state.
Stored session alone is never authorization. Async generation/deadline invalidation
prevents stale publication. Logout blocks subsequent events for this bootstrap lifetime,
clears credentials, and closes private navigation. Later login UX is out of scope.
Client config persistSession/autoRefreshToken true, detectSessionInUrl false,
processLock and URL polyfill. One AppState subscription owns active refresh and teardown.
No real configuration file or live auth was required/used in this stage.

Secure storage: asynchronous SecureStore backend, serialized operations, 2 deterministic
banks of at most 64 UTF-8 chunks <=1200 bytes each; version/count/bank/length/checksum
manifest replaced after writes. Reads reject incomplete/corrupt sets and clean orphan
bank; failure tries full cleanup, then throws sanitized AuthStorageError. Removal
attempts manifest and every fixed chunk key. Native deletion failure remains explicit;
no claim of guaranteed erasure/transactional behavior on failing hardware. No encryption
library. Checksum detects corruption only. Process death/platform atomicity is a device gate.

Environment validates absolute URLs, rejects credentials/query/hash, HTTPS required
except explicit development loopback/private IPv4 LAN. Only publishable key format is
accepted. Missing config shows honest diagnostic state, no fallback or secrets. All
three .env.example values blank. Native API transport uses Expo fetch's native
redirect:error enforcement, reviewed in installed iOS/Android source. API restricts
base-origin/API paths, finite timeout/AbortController, 256 KiB streamed JSON,
shape validator, stable sanitized outcomes/401, and zero retries. No live API probe.
Full refresh/retry orchestration belongs to MOBILE_AUTH_01; frozen save replay preserved
as a future contract, not implemented. HTTP-only mobile contract preserves NEXT16 gate.

Approved root setup/session helpers imported directly; completion helper takes an
injected fixed UUID only in synthetic local diagnostics/tests. No copied invariants
or root helper changes. Production random UUID adapter deferred. Metro watches root
interviews folder, keeps Expo hierarchical default, and rejects every resolved external
source/asset except exact three-helper allowlist. No broad root alias inheritance.

## 7. Public interfaces, props and types

- Configuration: discriminated Configuration; Environment contains public origins/key;
  validateEnvironment(values, development), readEnvironment().
- SecureBackend getItemAsync/setItemAsync/deleteItemAsync; createChunkedStorage returns
  async getItem/setItem/removeItem; AuthStorageError exposes no stored values.
- BootstrapState: checking/unauthenticated/authenticated/configuration-error/auth-error;
  authenticated state carries verified userId/token internally and generation.
  createBootstrap exposes logout/dispose; createNativeAuth exposes client/clear/start/stop.
- AuthProvider/useAuth bridges state and logout. No credentials rendered/logged.
- ApiResult<T> success/data or failure/code/status; Transport; createApiClient.request<T>
  accepts path/current verified token/shape guard and signal/timeout/method/body options.
  createNativeApiClient binds Expo fetch. Caller uses verified auth state, server verifies
  again. No providers or Next implementation types imported.
- AdaptiveShell props title/children/secondary; layoutClass(width,fontScale) returns
  compact/medium/expanded; ArchitectureProbe privateProbe flag; domainProbe boolean.

## 8. Accessibility decisions

SafeAreaProvider/View, scrollable content, keyboard avoidance, growing text without
fixed-height clipping, labels/header/live-region status, >=44-unit controls and visible
focus border. Status uses text, not color alone. No animations/reduced-motion conflict.
Text scaling adjusts layout class. Provisional two-pane expanded layout, bounded medium,
single-column compact. Keyboard/pointer/screen-reader/focus/rotation/split-view behavior
is architectural preparation, NOT real-device acceptance or final screen design.

## 9. Styling and token usage

mobile/src/theme/tokens.ts names CSS source token classes. Colors: canvas #F4F6FB,
surface #FFFFFF, lavender #F7F5FF, text #202944, secondary #475569, border #E8E8F2,
focus #7657E8. Spacing 8/16/24/32 from space-2/4/6/8; radius 12 from radius-md;
body/title 16/24 from md/2xl; weight 400/600; control 44 from button-height-md.
System font is canonical CSS fallback. Styles in separate file. Container max widths
840/1400 and thresholds 600/1000 are diagnostic geometry, not frozen product tokens.
No second palette. Generated icon/splash artwork is a non-production template asset.

Sandbox Hermes attempts failed permission denied writing temporary index.hbc (exit 6
compiler; export exit 1); elevated retries passed. Exports reported NO_COLOR ignored
because FORCE_COLOR set; compiler diagnostics from failed sandbox attempts included
undeclared runtime globals and eval warnings. No hidden package/version override.
Mobile initial TypeScript nullable AppState error corrected. Initial root test attempt
603/611 passed; eight PDF tests failed spawnSync python EOF. Existing bundled interpreter
resolved it; focused PDF 14/14 and subsequent entire 611 suite passed. No installs or
root test/source modifications. Supabase/provider/network behavior in tests is mocked.

Audit JSON never written to repo or TEMP; no audit temporary file needs removal.
Read-only audit count: four direct aggregate entries expo/react-native/reanimated/worklets
and 15 transitive entries. Actual advisory roots: braces <=3.0.3 (GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm,
pattern stack exhaustion through Metro/micromatch) and node-forge <=1.4.0
(GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv, signature parsing through CLI/signing tooling). Both absent from
native runtime maps; tooling attack surface remains, no proven app-runtime high/critical
path from this audit. Aggregate package counts are not independent exploitable defects.
No audit fix/downgrade/override. Official template superset retained: some direct template
entries (e.g. expo-device/web-oriented support) have no direct app-source imports; no
root package inheritance/HeyGen chain. Dependency minimization needs separate scoped
review, not an implicit package change. Root recorded 18-entry debt unchanged.

Local inventory: adb/java/emulator/eas/xcodebuild absent on PATH; default Android Studio,
Android SDK, Java and .android/avd locations absent. Windows, no local Xcode. No tools
installed. JS exports possible; native/device acceptance not presently demonstrated.
No universal claim that custom-location tools or attached devices cannot exist.

### docs/02_Decisions/ADR-006-mobile-architecture.md

```diff
diff --git a/docs/02_Decisions/ADR-006-mobile-architecture.md b/docs/02_Decisions/ADR-006-mobile-architecture.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..5a2e968
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/02_Decisions/ADR-006-mobile-architecture.md
@@ -0,0 +1,73 @@
+# ADR-006: Bounded native mobile architecture
+
+## Status / Date
+
+2026-10-22 (Europe/Istanbul). Architecture and bootstrap explicitly authorized;
+validated implementation awaits review. MOBILE_ARCHITECTURE_01 is NOT COMPLETE.
+No Git closure, native/cloud builds, signing or next-stage authority.
+
+## Context
+
+APP-first is canonical; iPhone, Android phone, iPad and Android tablet are APP V1
+targets. Base feature/auth-foundation, d4e1dd55657766eb414854ec1993164c239e154f.
+User selected SDK 58 stable and Expo Router (superseding Phase 1's direct React
+Navigation proposal). Official default template 58.0.26 verified before creation;
+Node 24.18.0 satisfies RN's ^22.13.0 || ^24.3.0 || >=26.0.0 requirement.
+
+## Decision
+
+Expo 58.0.17, React Native 0.88.0, React 19.3.0, Expo Router 58.0.25 and development
+client 58.0.14. Expo Go is not the compatibility target. Root Next remains, with
+isolated /mobile manifest/lockfile/node_modules and strict TypeScript. No workspaces.
+Root tsconfig excludes mobile/**. Metro keeps Expo default hierarchical lookup
+and rejects all external resolved files except three approved pure interview helpers.
+Completion proof injects a synthetic UUID; no root helper changes or duplicated rules.
+
+Supabase is auth-only. SecureStore asynchronous two-bank bounded chunks use versioned
+commit metadata, validation and fail-closed errors. No plaintext AsyncStorage or
+custom encryption dependency. Hydration verifies getUser(access_token), gates private
+routes and invalidates old identity generations. AppState owns foreground refresh.
+Logout closes private navigation and clears credentials; full auth/link/recovery UX
+is deferred. Native storage transaction/erasure behavior is not yet device-proven.
+
+Talentry backend owns application data/providers. Expo fetch transport rejects redirects;
+typed API client restricts origin, sanitizes failures, bounds consumption and supports
+cancellation/timeout without retries. No API request from this diagnostic. Future
+completion replay preserves frozen identity/payload. Detail/delete/PDF need separately
+approved bearer coverage, with no direct Supabase data bypass.
+
+Width/font-scale compact/medium/expanded classes are provisional probes; expanded uses
+two panes. Token subset derives from approved CSS. Real device/accessibility acceptance
+remains open. EAS development/simulator profiles express future builds only; no production
+identifiers, projectId, signing or account linking. Interview/recovery entry implementations
+are deferred to their stages; public/private group structure is available.
+
+## Alternatives considered
+
+Bare React Native, root relocation to apps/web, workspace conversion and separate repo
+were not selected. No mandatory integration invalidates the authorized Expo path.
+Root WEB React 19.3.1 is not imposed on mobile.
+
+## Consequences / Risks
+
+15 mobile tests, TypeScript, Doctor 20/20 and both Hermes exports pass. Root 611 tests,
+TypeScript/build pass. No native installation, real auth, secure-store device acceptance,
+redirect/device acceptance or tablet acceptance. Chunk metadata is not a proven native
+transaction. Persistent storage failures cannot guarantee physical erasure. Production
+UUID adapter remains deferred. Template dependency superset remains; 19 high audit entries
+trace to two tooling advisory chains, absent from runtime maps. Root 18-entry audit debt
+and durable/distributed provider quota production gates remain open. No production approval.
+
+## Rollback approach
+
+Future removal/replacement needs separate authorization. Preserve root baseline and
+historical reports; no automatic reset, restore, deletion or Git mutation.
+
+## Related stages and preserved gates
+
+APP_STRATEGY_FREEZE_01; SECURITY_PRIVACY_01; NEXT15_SECURITY_UPGRADE_GATE_01;
+MOBILE_ARCHITECTURE_01_PHASE_2; future MOBILE_AUTH_01/MOBILE_MEDIA_01/SESSION_RESUME_01.
+NEXT16_READINESS_GATE remains deferred: mobile consumes HTTP contracts, not Next imports.
+New public-schema migrations after the approved 30 October 2026 policy change jointly
+define least-privilege GRANTs, RLS and policies, with fresh/preview/db-reset verification.
+No schema, providers, media, HeyGen, payments, push or resume persistence changes.
```

### mobile/README.md

```diff
diff --git a/mobile/README.md b/mobile/README.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..5a6c2a7
--- /dev/null
+++ b/mobile/README.md
@@ -0,0 +1,61 @@
+# Talentry mobile architecture probe
+
+Validated: 15 mocked/domain tests; TypeScript; Expo compatibility; Doctor 20/20;
+Android and iOS Hermes exports. Bundle evidence is not native/device acceptance.
+
+## Verified architecture
+
+Expo SDK 58 + Expo Router development-build shell, with bootstrap/public/private
+diagnostic routes. Auth tests cover verified hydration, mismatch/stale rejection,
+logout, one AppState registration and foreground-only refresh. Native auth,
+route transitions and absence of private-content flash are not device-tested.
+Supabase is auth-only; no live auth/API/data requests were made during validation.
+
+SecureStore uses serialized two-bank storage: at most 64 chunks of 1200 UTF-8
+bytes per bank and versioned metadata as commit point. Tests cover Unicode,
+rotation, partial writes, missing/corrupt sets, orphan cleanup, oversize input,
+read/delete errors and logout deletion. Checksum is for corruption detection,
+not cryptographic integrity. Actual Keychain/Keystore atomicity, process death
+and persistent deletion failures remain device gates; physical erasure cannot
+be guaranteed when the native store fails. No plaintext AsyncStorage.
+
+API tests cover approved-origin bearer attachment, redirect:error configuration,
+401, sanitized errors, 256 KiB consumed JSON cap, timeout/cancellation and no
+retry. Native transport is expo/fetch; its redirect enforcement was source-reviewed,
+not live/device-tested. No API action runs from this probe. Full refresh/retry UX
+belongs to MOBILE_AUTH_01; future save replay must preserve frozen ID/payload.
+
+Both exported maps contain the three approved root interview helpers and one
+React entry. Metro guard tests reject root React, provider and browser files.
+Root/mobile manifests, lockfiles, node_modules and TypeScript configs are separate.
+No workspaces. Completion reuse injects a fixed UUID only in the synthetic local
+probe; production UUID generation is deferred, with root helper unchanged.
+
+Layout-class tests cover compact/medium/expanded widths and large text. Probe
+thresholds are 600/1000 effective width after font scaling, not final breakpoints.
+The shell contains safe-area, keyboard-avoidance, scrolling and expanded panes;
+real keyboard/pointer/accessibility/tablet resizing is not accepted yet. Token
+values project styles/talentry-tokens.css; native system font fallback is used.
+No animations. Generated icon/splash assets are non-production placeholders.
+
+## Commands and configuration
+
+Run from mobile: npm test; npm run typecheck; npx expo install --check;
+npx expo-doctor. Start scripts target development clients. Server/native/cloud
+build execution, signing and stores require separate authorization. Expo Go is
+not the compatibility target. EAS profiles are configuration only; no projectId,
+final bundle/package identifiers, account linking or signing credentials exist.
+The talentry-bootstrap scheme is non-production; auth callbacks are deferred.
+
+.env.example contains only public configuration names, with no real values.
+Tests cover missing/malformed config, privileged key rejection and HTTPS except
+explicit development loopback/private IPv4 LAN addresses. No production fallback.
+Real-device localhost means the device, not the developer computer.
+
+Detail/delete/PDF require a later backend bearer extension; no direct Supabase
+application-data bypass. Full auth/recovery UX, interviews, media, payments, push
+and durable resume are deferred. SDK 58 template dependencies remain a superset;
+no root packages or HeyGen chains were inherited. Audit: 19 high package entries,
+zero critical, from braces/Metro and node-forge tooling; neither vulnerable module
+appears in exported runtime maps. Production dependency review remains open.
+No audit fix. Audit JSON stayed in memory/stdout, exports under OS TEMP.
```

```diff
+import { Redirect, Stack } from 'expo-router'
+import { useAuth } from '../../src/auth/AuthProvider'
+export default function PrivateLayout() {
+  const { state } = useAuth()
+  if (state.status !== 'authenticated') return <Redirect href="/" />
+  return <Stack key={`${state.userId}:${state.generation}`} screenOptions={{ headerShown: false }} />
```

```diff
+  const authenticated = state.status === 'authenticated'
+  return <Stack screenOptions={{ headerShown: false }}>
+    <Stack.Screen name="index" />
+    <Stack.Protected guard={!authenticated}><Stack.Screen name="(public)" /></Stack.Protected>
+    <Stack.Protected guard={authenticated}><Stack.Screen name="(authenticated)" /></Stack.Protected>
+  </Stack>
+}
+export default function RootLayout() {
+  return <SafeAreaProvider><AuthProvider><Routes /></AuthProvider></SafeAreaProvider>
+}
```

### mobile/app/index.tsx

```diff
diff --git a/mobile/app/index.tsx b/mobile/app/index.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..0b29d22
--- /dev/null
+++ b/mobile/app/index.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+import { Redirect } from 'expo-router'
+import { useAuth } from '../src/auth/AuthProvider'
+import { ArchitectureProbe } from '../src/diagnostics/ArchitectureProbe'
+export default function BootstrapRoute() {
+  const { state } = useAuth()
+  if (state.status === 'checking') return <ArchitectureProbe />
+  return <Redirect href={state.status === 'authenticated' ? '/(authenticated)/probe' : '/(public)/probe'} />
+}
```

### mobile/metro.config.js

```diff
diff --git a/mobile/metro.config.js b/mobile/metro.config.js
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..47d1960
--- /dev/null
+++ b/mobile/metro.config.js
@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+const path = require('node:path')
+const { getDefaultConfig } = require('expo/metro-config')
+const config = getDefaultConfig(__dirname)
+const domain = path.resolve(__dirname, '../lib/interviews')
+const allowed = new Set(['interview-setup-input.ts', 'interview-session-state.ts', 'interview-completion-state.ts'])
+config.watchFolders = [domain]
+// Keep Expo's default hierarchical lookup. The result allowlist below rejects all
+// root dependency fallback; approved external helpers have no runtime imports.
+config.resolver.nodeModulesPaths = [path.join(__dirname, 'node_modules')]
+config.resolver.resolveRequest = (context, moduleName, platform) => {
+  const result = context.resolveRequest(context, moduleName, platform)
+  const files = result.type === 'sourceFile' ? [result.filePath] : result.type === 'assetFiles' ? result.filePaths : []
+  for (const file of files) {
+    const absolute = path.resolve(file)
+    const relative = path.relative(__dirname, absolute)
+    const inMobile = relative !== '..' && !relative.startsWith(`..${path.sep}`) && !path.isAbsolute(relative)
+    if (!inMobile && !(path.dirname(absolute) === domain && allowed.has(path.basename(absolute)))) {
+      throw new Error('Native graph attempted an unapproved external import')
+    }
+  }
+  return result
+}
+module.exports = config
```

### mobile/src/api/client.test.cjs

```diff
diff --git a/mobile/src/api/client.test.cjs b/mobile/src/api/client.test.cjs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..61ad84e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/mobile/src/api/client.test.cjs
@@ -0,0 +1,44 @@
+const { test } = require('node:test')
+const assert = require('node:assert/strict')
+const { load } = require('../diagnostics/test-loader.cjs')
+const { createApiClient } = load(require.resolve('./client.ts'))
+const valid = value => value?.ready === true
+test('bearer restricted to base API and redirects rejected; no implicit retries', async () => {
+  let calls = 0
+  const client = createApiClient('https://talentry.example', async (url, init) => {
+    calls++
+    assert.equal(url, 'https://talentry.example/api/probe')
+    assert.equal(init.redirect, 'error')
+    assert.equal(init.headers.Authorization, 'Bearer test-token')
+    return Response.json({ ready: true })
+  })
+  assert.deepEqual(await client.request('api/probe', 'test-token', valid), { ok: true, data: { ready: true } })
+  for (const path of ['https://evil.example/api/probe', '//evil.example/api/probe', 'api/../../secret', 'api/\\evil']) {
+    assert.equal((await client.request(path, 'test-token', valid)).error, 'invalid-request')
+  }
+  assert.equal(calls, 1)
+})
+test('401, malformed response, oversized stream and HTTP failure are sanitized', async () => {
+  for (const [response, expected] of [
+    [new Response('private raw', { status: 401 }), 'auth-expired'],
+    [new Response('private raw', { status: 503 }), 'http-error'],
+    [new Response('{', { headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' } }), 'invalid-response'],
+    [Response.json({ private: 'x'.repeat(270000) }), 'invalid-response'],
+  ]) {
+    let calls = 0
+    const client = createApiClient('https://talentry.example', async () => { calls++; return response })
+    const result = await client.request('api/probe', 'token', valid)
+    assert.equal(result.error, expected); assert.equal(calls, 1)
+    assert.ok(!JSON.stringify(result).includes('private'))
+  }
+})
+test('timeout and caller cancellation terminate transport without retry', async () => {
+  const client = createApiClient('https://talentry.example', (_url, init) => new Promise((_resolve, reject) => {
+    init.signal.addEventListener('abort', () => reject(Error()), { once: true })
+  }))
+  assert.equal((await client.request('api/probe', 'token', valid, { timeoutMs: 5 })).error, 'timeout')
+  const controller = new AbortController()
+  const pending = client.request('api/probe', 'token', valid, { signal: controller.signal })
+  controller.abort()
+  assert.equal((await pending).error, 'cancelled')
+})
```

### mobile/src/api/client.ts

```diff
diff --git a/mobile/src/api/client.ts b/mobile/src/api/client.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..201d88e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/mobile/src/api/client.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,55 @@
+export type ApiError = 'auth-expired' | 'cancelled' | 'timeout' | 'network' | 'invalid-response' | 'http-error' | 'invalid-request'
+export type ApiResult<T> = { ok: true; data: T } | { ok: false; error: ApiError; status?: number }
+export type Transport = (url: string, init: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>
+
+/** No retries. Transport must enforce redirect:error natively (Expo fetch, not RN global fetch). */
+export function createApiClient(baseUrl: string, transport: Transport) {
+  const base = new URL(`${baseUrl.replace(/\/$/, '')}/`)
+  return {
+    async request<T>(path: string, token: string, validate: (value: unknown) => value is T,
+      options: { signal?: AbortSignal; timeoutMs?: number; method?: 'GET' | 'POST'; body?: unknown } = {}): Promise<ApiResult<T>> {
+      const controller = new AbortController()
+      let timedOut = false
+      const abort = () => controller.abort()
+      const timeoutMs = options.timeoutMs ?? 15000
+      if (!token || /\s/.test(token) || !Number.isFinite(timeoutMs) || timeoutMs < 1 || timeoutMs > 60000 ||
+          !path.startsWith('api/') || path.includes('\\') || path.includes('#')) return { ok: false, error: 'invalid-request' }
+      let url: URL
+      try { url = new URL(path, base) } catch { return { ok: false, error: 'invalid-request' } }
+      if (url.origin !== base.origin || !url.pathname.startsWith(`${base.pathname}api/`)) return { ok: false, error: 'invalid-request' }
+      if (options.signal?.aborted) return { ok: false, error: 'cancelled' }
+      options.signal?.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true })
+      const timer = setTimeout(() => { timedOut = true; controller.abort() }, timeoutMs)
+      try {
+        const response = await transport(url.toString(), {
+          method: options.method ?? 'GET', redirect: 'error', credentials: 'omit', signal: controller.signal,
+          headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, Accept: 'application/json', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+          body: options.body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(options.body),
+        })
+        if (response.redirected || (response.url && new URL(response.url).origin !== base.origin)) return { ok: false, error: 'invalid-response' }
+        if (response.status === 401) return { ok: false, error: 'auth-expired', status: 401 }
+        if (!response.ok) return { ok: false, error: 'http-error', status: response.status }
+        if (!response.headers.get('content-type')?.includes('application/json') || !response.body) return { ok: false, error: 'invalid-response' }
+        const reader = response.body.getReader()
+        const decoder = new TextDecoder()
+        let bytes = 0, text = ''
+        try {
+          while (true) {
+            const chunk = await reader.read()
+            if (chunk.done) break
+            bytes += chunk.value.byteLength
+            if (bytes > 256 * 1024) return { ok: false, error: 'invalid-response' }
+            text += decoder.decode(chunk.value, { stream: true })
+          }
+          text += decoder.decode()
+        } finally { await reader.cancel().catch(() => {}); reader.releaseLock() }
+        if (controller.signal.aborted) return { ok: false, error: timedOut ? 'timeout' : 'cancelled' }
+        let value: unknown
+        try { value = JSON.parse(text) } catch { return { ok: false, error: 'invalid-response' } }
+        return validate(value) ? { ok: true, data: value } : { ok: false, error: 'invalid-response' }
+      } catch {
+        return { ok: false, error: controller.signal.aborted ? (timedOut ? 'timeout' : 'cancelled') : 'network' }
+      } finally { clearTimeout(timer); options.signal?.removeEventListener('abort', abort); controller.abort() }
+    },
+  }
+}
```

### mobile/src/auth/AuthProvider.tsx

```diff
diff --git a/mobile/src/auth/AuthProvider.tsx b/mobile/src/auth/AuthProvider.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..242051b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/mobile/src/auth/AuthProvider.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState, type PropsWithChildren } from 'react'
+import { readEnvironment } from '../config/environment'
+import { createNativeAuth } from './client'
+import { createBootstrap, type BootstrapState } from './bootstrap'
+
+const Context = createContext<{ state: BootstrapState; logout: () => Promise<void> }>({
+  state: { status: 'checking', generation: 0 }, logout: async () => {},
+})
+export function AuthProvider({ children }: PropsWithChildren) {
+  const [state, setState] = useState<BootstrapState>({ status: 'checking', generation: 0 })
+  const [logout, setLogout] = useState<() => Promise<void>>(() => async () => {})
+  useEffect(() => {
+    const config = readEnvironment()
+    if (!config.ok) { setState({ status: 'configuration-error', generation: 0 }); return }
+    try {
+      const native = createNativeAuth(config.value)
+      const bootstrap = createBootstrap(native.client.auth, native.clear, setState)
+      native.start()
+      setLogout(() => bootstrap.logout)
+      return () => { bootstrap.dispose(); native.stop() }
+    } catch { setState({ status: 'auth-error', generation: 0 }) }
+  }, [])
+  return <Context.Provider value={{ state, logout }}>{children}</Context.Provider>
+}
+export const useAuth = () => useContext(Context)
```

### mobile/src/auth/bootstrap.ts

```diff
diff --git a/mobile/src/auth/bootstrap.ts b/mobile/src/auth/bootstrap.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..9f14991
--- /dev/null
+++ b/mobile/src/auth/bootstrap.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,56 @@
+import type { Session, SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'
+export type BootstrapState =
+  | { status: 'checking' | 'unauthenticated' | 'configuration-error' | 'auth-error'; generation: number }
+  | { status: 'authenticated'; generation: number; userId: string; accessToken: string }
+
+/** Verification and stale-response ownership live outside the presentation layer. */
+export function createBootstrap(auth: SupabaseClient['auth'], clear: () => Promise<void>, publish: (state: BootstrapState) => void) {
+  let disposed = false, generation = 0
+  let loggedOut = false
+  let task: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined
+  let deadline: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined
+  const emit = (state: BootstrapState) => { if (!disposed) publish(state) }
+  async function verify(ticket: number) {
+    try {
+      const { data: { session }, error } = await auth.getSession()
+      if (disposed || ticket !== generation) return
+      if (error) throw Error()
+      if (!session) { emit({ status: 'unauthenticated', generation: ticket }); return }
+      const result = await auth.getUser(session.access_token)
+      if (disposed || ticket !== generation) return
+      if (result.error || !result.data.user || result.data.user.id !== session.user.id) throw Error()
+      emit({ status: 'authenticated', generation: ticket, userId: result.data.user.id, accessToken: session.access_token })
+    } catch {
+      if (!disposed && ticket === generation) emit({ status: 'auth-error', generation: ticket })
+    } finally { if (ticket === generation) clearTimeout(deadline) }
+  }
+  function schedule(_session?: Session | null) {
+    if (loggedOut || disposed) return
+    const ticket = ++generation
+    clearTimeout(task); clearTimeout(deadline)
+    emit({ status: 'checking', generation: ticket }) // Unmount old account's private tree immediately.
+    deadline = setTimeout(() => {
+      if (ticket !== generation || disposed) return
+      ++generation
+      emit({ status: 'auth-error', generation })
+    }, 12000)
+    // Avoid SDK auth lock re-entry inside the synchronous auth callback.
+    task = setTimeout(() => { void verify(ticket) }, 0)
+  }
+  const { data: { subscription } } = auth.onAuthStateChange((_event, session) => schedule(session))
+  schedule()
+  return {
+    async logout() {
+      loggedOut = true
+      const ticket = ++generation
+      clearTimeout(task); clearTimeout(deadline)
+      emit({ status: 'checking', generation: ticket })
+      let failed = false
+      try { const result = await auth.signOut({ scope: 'local' }); failed = !!result.error } catch { failed = true }
+      try { await clear() } catch { failed = true }
+      clearTimeout(task); clearTimeout(deadline)
+      emit({ status: failed ? 'auth-error' : 'unauthenticated', generation: ++generation })
+    },
+    dispose() { disposed = true; ++generation; clearTimeout(task); clearTimeout(deadline); subscription.unsubscribe() },
+  }
+}
```

```diff
+const { test } = require('node:test')
+const assert = require('node:assert/strict')
+const { load } = require('../diagnostics/test-loader.cjs')
+const { createChunkedStorage } = load(require.resolve('./chunked-storage.ts'))
+function fixture() {
+  const values = new Map()
+  let failSet = 0
+  const backend = {
+    async getItemAsync(key) { return values.get(key) ?? null },
+    async setItemAsync(key, value) { if (failSet && --failSet === 0) throw Error('native'); values.set(key, value) },
+    async deleteItemAsync(key) { values.delete(key) },
+  }
+  return { values, backend, storage: createChunkedStorage(backend), failWriteAt: value => { failSet = value } }
+}
+test('large Unicode sessions round trip with bounded native values; rotate and logout remove all chunks', async () => {
+  const f = fixture(), value = JSON.stringify({ token: '😀é'.repeat(6000) })
+  await f.storage.setItem('session', value)
+  assert.equal(await f.storage.getItem('session'), value)
+  for (const part of f.values.values()) assert.ok(Buffer.byteLength(part) <= 1200)
+  await f.storage.setItem('session', 'replacement')
+  assert.equal(await f.storage.getItem('session'), 'replacement')
+  assert.equal(f.values.size, 2)
+  await f.storage.removeItem('session')
+  assert.equal(f.values.size, 0)
+})
+test('partial write fails closed and cleans both banks', async () => {
+  const f = fixture()
+  await f.storage.setItem('session', 'old')
+  f.failWriteAt(2)
+  await assert.rejects(f.storage.setItem('session', 'x'.repeat(4000)), /Secure session/)
+  assert.equal(f.values.size, 0)
+})
+test('incomplete or corrupted committed set is rejected and removed', async () => {
+  for (const corrupt of [true, false]) {
+    const f = fixture()
+    await f.storage.setItem('session', 'x'.repeat(2000))
+    const key = [...f.values.keys()].find(k => k.endsWith('.0.0'))
+    if (corrupt) f.values.set(key, 'wrong'); else f.values.delete(key)
+    await assert.rejects(f.storage.getItem('session'), /Secure session/)
+    assert.equal(f.values.size, 0)
+  }
+})
+test('oversize data, read failures and deletion failures are explicit', async () => {
+  const f = fixture()
+  await assert.rejects(f.storage.setItem('session', 'x'.repeat(78000)))
+  const broken = createChunkedStorage({ ...f.backend, async getItemAsync() { throw Error() } })
+  await assert.rejects(broken.getItem('session'))
+  const deletion = createChunkedStorage({ ...f.backend, async deleteItemAsync() { throw Error() } })
+  await assert.rejects(deletion.removeItem('session'))
+})
+test('orphan inactive writes after process death are cleaned, committed bank remains readable', async () => {
+  const f = fixture()
+  await f.storage.setItem('session', 'committed')
+  f.values.set('talentry.auth.v1.session.1.0', 'unfinished')
+  assert.equal(await f.storage.getItem('session'), 'committed')
+  assert.equal(f.values.size, 2)
+})
```

### mobile/src/auth/chunked-storage.ts

```diff
diff --git a/mobile/src/auth/chunked-storage.ts b/mobile/src/auth/chunked-storage.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..029edf5
--- /dev/null
+++ b/mobile/src/auth/chunked-storage.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,102 @@
+export interface SecureBackend {
+  getItemAsync(key: string): Promise<string | null>
+  setItemAsync(key: string, value: string): Promise<void>
+  deleteItemAsync(key: string): Promise<void>
+}
+const MAX_CHUNKS = 64
+const CHUNK_BYTES = 1200
+type Manifest = { version: 1; bank: 0 | 1; count: number; length: number; checksum: number }
+export class AuthStorageError extends Error {
+  constructor() { super('Secure session storage unavailable or incomplete') }
+}
+function checksum(value: string) {
+  let hash = 2166136261
+  for (let i = 0; i < value.length; i++) hash = Math.imul(hash ^ value.charCodeAt(i), 16777619)
+  return hash >>> 0 // Corruption detection only; SecureStore supplies confidentiality.
+}
+function chunksOf(value: string) {
+  const chunks: string[] = []
+  let chunk = '', bytes = 0
+  for (const char of value) {
+    const code = char.codePointAt(0)!
+    const size = code <= 127 ? 1 : code <= 2047 ? 2 : code <= 65535 ? 3 : 4
+    if (bytes + size > CHUNK_BYTES) { chunks.push(chunk); chunk = ''; bytes = 0 }
+    chunk += char; bytes += size
+    if (chunks.length >= MAX_CHUNKS) throw new AuthStorageError()
+  }
+  chunks.push(chunk)
+  return chunks
+}
+function parseManifest(raw: string): Manifest {
+  const item: unknown = JSON.parse(raw)
+  if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') throw new AuthStorageError()
+  const m = item as Partial<Manifest>
+  if (m.version !== 1 || (m.bank !== 0 && m.bank !== 1) || !Number.isInteger(m.count) ||
+      m.count! < 1 || m.count! > MAX_CHUNKS || !Number.isInteger(m.length) || m.length! < 0 ||
+      m.length! > MAX_CHUNKS * CHUNK_BYTES || !Number.isInteger(m.checksum)) throw new AuthStorageError()
+  return m as Manifest
+}
+
+/** Serialized, two-bank storage. Manifest replacement is the commit point, not a filesystem transaction. */
+export function createChunkedStorage(backend: SecureBackend) {
+  let queue: Promise<unknown> = Promise.resolve()
+  const prefix = (key: string) => {
+    if (!/^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{1,180}$/.test(key)) throw new AuthStorageError()
+    return `talentry.auth.v1.${key}`
+  }
+  const part = (base: string, bank: number, index: number) => `${base}.${bank}.${index}`
+  async function clear(base: string, bank?: number) {
+    let failed = false
+    const keys = bank === undefined ? [base, ...[0, 1].flatMap(b => Array.from({ length: MAX_CHUNKS }, (_, i) => part(base, b, i)))]
+      : Array.from({ length: MAX_CHUNKS }, (_, i) => part(base, bank, i))
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      try { await backend.deleteItemAsync(key) } catch { failed = true }
+    }
+    if (failed) throw new AuthStorageError()
+  }
+  function serialized<T>(work: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
+    const result = queue.then(work)
+    queue = result.catch(() => {})
+    return result
+  }
+  async function guarded<T>(key: string, work: (base: string) => Promise<T>) {
+    const base = prefix(key)
+    try { return await work(base) }
+    catch {
+      try { await clear(base) } catch { /* Still fail closed; no credentials returned. */ }
+      throw new AuthStorageError()
+    }
+  }
+  return {
+    getItem(key: string): Promise<string | null> {
+      return serialized(() => guarded(key, async base => {
+        const raw = await backend.getItemAsync(base)
+        if (raw === null) { await clear(base); return null }
+        const manifest = parseManifest(raw)
+        const chunks: string[] = []
+        for (let i = 0; i < manifest.count; i++) {
+          const chunk = await backend.getItemAsync(part(base, manifest.bank, i))
+          if (chunk === null || chunk.length > CHUNK_BYTES) throw new AuthStorageError()
+          chunks.push(chunk)
+        }
+        const value = chunks.join('')
+        if (value.length !== manifest.length || checksum(value) !== manifest.checksum) throw new AuthStorageError()
+        await clear(base, manifest.bank === 0 ? 1 : 0)
+        return value
+      }))
+    },
+    setItem(key: string, value: string): Promise<void> {
+      return serialized(() => guarded(key, async base => {
+        const chunks = chunksOf(value)
+        const old = await backend.getItemAsync(base)
+        const bank = old === null || parseManifest(old).bank === 1 ? 0 : 1
+        await clear(base, bank)
+        for (let i = 0; i < chunks.length; i++) await backend.setItemAsync(part(base, bank, i), chunks[i])
+        await backend.setItemAsync(base, JSON.stringify({ version: 1, bank, count: chunks.length,
+          length: value.length, checksum: checksum(value) } satisfies Manifest))
+        await clear(base, bank === 0 ? 1 : 0)
+      }))
+    },
+    removeItem(key: string): Promise<void> { return serialized(() => guarded(key, clear)) },
+  }
+}
```

```diff
+    '@supabase/supabase-js': { processLock: () => {}, createClient(_url, _key, options) {
```

### mobile/src/auth/client.ts

```diff
diff --git a/mobile/src/auth/client.ts b/mobile/src/auth/client.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..2a53683
--- /dev/null
+++ b/mobile/src/auth/client.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,33 @@
+import 'react-native-url-polyfill/auto'
+import { createClient, processLock } from '@supabase/supabase-js'
+import * as SecureStore from 'expo-secure-store'
+import { AppState } from 'react-native'
+import type { Environment } from '../config/environment'
+import { createChunkedStorage } from './chunked-storage'
+
+export function createNativeAuth(config: Environment) {
+  const storage = createChunkedStorage({
+    getItemAsync: key => SecureStore.getItemAsync(key),
+    setItemAsync: (key, value) => SecureStore.setItemAsync(key, value),
+    deleteItemAsync: key => SecureStore.deleteItemAsync(key),
+  })
+  const storageKey = 'talentry-session'
+  const client = createClient(config.supabaseUrl, config.publishableKey, {
+    auth: { storage, storageKey, persistSession: true, autoRefreshToken: true, detectSessionInUrl: false, lock: processLock },
+  })
+  let registration: ReturnType<typeof AppState.addEventListener> | undefined
+  return {
+    client,
+    clear: () => storage.removeItem(storageKey),
+    start() {
+      if (registration) return
+      const sync = (state: string | null | undefined) => {
+        if (state === 'active') client.auth.startAutoRefresh()
+        else client.auth.stopAutoRefresh()
+      }
+      sync(AppState.currentState)
+      registration = AppState.addEventListener('change', sync)
+    },
+    stop() { registration?.remove(); registration = undefined; client.auth.stopAutoRefresh() },
+  }
+}
```

### mobile/src/config/environment.ts

```diff
diff --git a/mobile/src/config/environment.ts b/mobile/src/config/environment.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..49078ba
--- /dev/null
+++ b/mobile/src/config/environment.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+export type Environment = Readonly<{ apiBaseUrl: string; supabaseUrl: string; publishableKey: string }>
+export type Configuration = { ok: true; value: Environment } | { ok: false; message: string }
+
+function localHostname(host: string) {
+  return host === 'localhost' || host === '127.0.0.1' || host === '[::1]' ||
+    /^10\.(?:\d{1,3}\.){2}\d{1,3}$/.test(host) || /^192\.168\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}$/.test(host) ||
+    /^172\.(?:1[6-9]|2\d|3[01])\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}$/.test(host)
+}
+
+export function validateEnvironment(values: readonly (string | undefined)[], development: boolean): Configuration {
+  try {
+    const [api, supabase, key] = values
+    if (!api || !supabase || !key?.trim()) throw Error()
+    const urls = [api, supabase].map(value => {
+      const url = new URL(value)
+      if (url.username || url.password || url.search || url.hash ||
+          (url.protocol !== 'https:' && !(development && url.protocol === 'http:' && localHostname(url.hostname)))) throw Error()
+      return url.toString().replace(/\/$/, '')
+    })
+    // Public keys only: reject legacy JWT keys carrying a privileged role.
+    if (!key.startsWith('sb_publishable_')) throw Error()
+    return { ok: true, value: { apiBaseUrl: urls[0], supabaseUrl: urls[1], publishableKey: key } }
+  } catch { return { ok: false, message: 'Mobile public configuration is missing or invalid. No backend fallback is used.' } }
+}
+
+export function readEnvironment(): Configuration {
+  return validateEnvironment([
+    process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_TALENTRY_API_BASE_URL,
+    process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL,
+    process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY,
+  ], __DEV__)
+}
```

```diff
+import { useState } from 'react'
+import { Pressable, Text, TextInput } from 'react-native'
+import { useAuth } from '../auth/AuthProvider'
+import { AdaptiveShell } from '../layout/AdaptiveShell'
+import { shellStyles as styles } from '../layout/shell-styles'
+import { domainProbe } from './domain-probe'
+import { createNativeApiClient } from '../api/native-client'
+
+export function ArchitectureProbe({ privateProbe = false }: { privateProbe?: boolean }) {
+  const { state, logout } = useAuth()
+  const [focused, setFocused] = useState(false)
+  return (
+    <AdaptiveShell title="Talentry architecture probe" secondary={<>
+      <Text style={styles.text}>Phone and tablet layout diagnostic. These thresholds are provisional.</Text>
+      <TextInput accessibilityLabel="Keyboard layout probe; do not enter private information" placeholder="Keyboard layout probe"
+        style={[styles.control, styles.text, focused && styles.focused]} onFocus={() => setFocused(true)} onBlur={() => setFocused(false)} />
+    </>}>
+      <Text accessibilityLiveRegion="polite" style={styles.text}>Authentication: {state.status}</Text>
+      <Text style={styles.text}>Shared domain import probe: {domainProbe() ? 'passed' : 'failed'}</Text>
+      <Text style={styles.text}>API contract: {typeof createNativeApiClient === 'function' ? 'available; no requests sent' : 'unavailable'}</Text>
+      <Text style={styles.text}>{privateProbe ? 'Authenticated diagnostic boundary.' : 'Public diagnostic boundary. Full authentication UX is deferred.'}</Text>
+      {state.status === 'configuration-error' && <Text style={styles.text}>Public configuration is absent or invalid. No backend fallback is used.</Text>}
+      {state.status === 'auth-error' && <Text style={styles.text}>Identity or secure storage could not be verified. Private navigation is closed.</Text>}
+      {privateProbe && <Pressable accessibilityRole="button" accessibilityLabel="Log out" onPress={() => { void logout() }}
+        onFocus={() => setFocused(true)} onBlur={() => setFocused(false)} style={[styles.control, focused && styles.focused]}>
+        <Text style={styles.text}>Log out</Text>
+      </Pressable>}
+    </AdaptiveShell>
+  )
+}
```

```diff
+import { parseInterviewSetupInput } from '../../../lib/interviews/interview-setup-input'
+import { createInterviewSessionState } from '../../../lib/interviews/interview-session-state'
+import { createInterviewCompletionState } from '../../../lib/interviews/interview-completion-state'
+
+/** Synthetic local invariant probe only. No provider, persistence, or business record. */
+export function domainProbe() {
+  const setup = parseInterviewSetupInput({ iv: 'f', level: 'junior', itype: 'technical', persona: 'friendly', language: 'en' })
+  const session = createInterviewSessionState()
+  const generation = session.beginGeneration()
+  const question = generation && session.acceptQuestion(generation.token, 'Local architecture probe')
+  if (generation) session.release(generation.token)
+  const first = session.claimAnswer('Local probe answer')
+  const duplicate = session.claimAnswer('Duplicate probe')
+  session.dispose()
+  // Injection proves root helper reuse without relying on the native global crypto API.
+  // Production random UUID adapter is deferred until interview-core implementation.
+  const completion = createInterviewCompletionState(() => '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001')
+  return !!setup && !!question && !!first && duplicate === null && completion.begin([]) === null &&
+    completion.begin([{ q: 'Probe', a: 'Probe' }]) === '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'
+}
```

```diff
+const fs = require('node:fs')
+const path = require('node:path')
+const ts = require('typescript')
+function load(file, overrides = {}) {
+  const absolute = path.resolve(file)
+  const code = ts.transpileModule(fs.readFileSync(absolute, 'utf8'), {
+    compilerOptions: { module: ts.ModuleKind.CommonJS, target: ts.ScriptTarget.ES2022 },
+  }).outputText
+  const module = { exports: {} }
+  const localRequire = name => Object.hasOwn(overrides, name) ? overrides[name] :
+    name.startsWith('.') ? load(path.resolve(path.dirname(absolute), name + '.ts'), overrides) : require(name)
+  new Function('require', 'module', 'exports', code)(localRequire, module, module.exports)
+  return module.exports
+}
+module.exports = { load }
```

```diff
+import type { ReactNode } from 'react'
+import { KeyboardAvoidingView, Platform, ScrollView, Text, View, useWindowDimensions } from 'react-native'
+import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context'
+import { layoutClass } from './layout-class'
+import { shellStyles as styles } from './shell-styles'
+
+export function AdaptiveShell({ title, children, secondary }: { title: string; children: ReactNode; secondary: ReactNode }) {
+  const { width, fontScale } = useWindowDimensions()
+  const layout = layoutClass(width, fontScale)
+  return (
+    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe}>
+      <KeyboardAvoidingView behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : 'height'} style={styles.fill}>
+        <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scroll} keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled">
+          <View style={[styles.container, layout === 'medium' && styles.medium]}>
+            <Text accessibilityRole="header" style={styles.title}>{title}</Text>
+            <Text style={styles.text}>Layout probe: {layout}. Window width: {Math.round(width)}.</Text>
+            <View style={[styles.panes, layout === 'expanded' && styles.expanded]}>
+              <View style={styles.pane}>{children}</View>
+              <View style={[styles.pane, styles.secondary]}>{secondary}</View>
+            </View>
+          </View>
+        </ScrollView>
+      </KeyboardAvoidingView>
+    </SafeAreaView>
+  )
+}
```

```diff
@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+export type LayoutClass = 'compact' | 'medium' | 'expanded'
+/** Probe thresholds only, not frozen product breakpoints. Account for usable width/text scale. */
+export function layoutClass(width: number, fontScale: number): LayoutClass {
+  const usable = width / Math.max(1, fontScale)
+  return usable < 600 ? 'compact' : usable < 1000 ? 'medium' : 'expanded'
+}
```
